title: Format a score line
prompt: Return "Score: N / M" from two numbers, so solve(7, 10) is "Score: 7 / 10".
hints: Two conversions, joined with the text in between.

docs.name: str(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as text (a String).

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings. Joining text to a number is an error; convert first.

solution:
func solve(score, best):
	return "Score: " + str(score) + " / " + str(best)
